schema: CREATE TABLE `shop_geo` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_offices` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `caption` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `city` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `address` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_offices_geo_map` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `office_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `geo_id` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_storages` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `currency` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 784, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `shop_currencies` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `iso_code` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `rate` decimal(15,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.000000, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_storages_data` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `storage_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `category_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `price` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `price_purchase` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `exist` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `reserved` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `issued` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `time_to_exe` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `arrival_time` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `shop_offices_storages_map` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `office_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `storage_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `min_point` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `max_point` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 999999999.00, `markup` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `additional_time` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `groups` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `for_guests` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `for_registrated` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))
CREATE TABLE `users_groups_bind` (`record_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`record_id`))
CREATE TABLE `epc_price_settings` (`setting_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `setting_value` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (`setting_key`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_profiles` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `code` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `vat_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_profile_brand_rules` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `manufacturer` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_profile_article_rules` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `manufacturer` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `article` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY (`id`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_storage_rules` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `storage_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `updated_at` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `x_storage` (`storage_id`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_storage_brand_rules` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `storage_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `manufacturer` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `updated_at` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `x_storage_brand` (`storage_id`, `manufacturer`))

CREATE TABLE `epc_price_storage_article_rules` (`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `storage_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `manufacturer` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `article` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `margin_percent` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00, `visible` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `updated_at` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `x_storage_brand_article` (`storage_id`, `manufacturer`, `article`))
